argv: const fs=require('node:fs');const net=require('node:net');let out={};for(const [k,p] of Object.entries(JSON.parse(process.argv[1]))){try{fs.readFileSync(p);out[k]='readable'}catch(e){out[k]=e.code}}try{fs.writeFileSync(process.argv[2],'synthetic boundary probe');out.outside_write='allowed'}catch(e){out.outside_write=e.code}console.log(JSON.stringify(out));const s=net.createServer();s.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',()=>{console.log('loopback_listen=allowed');s.close()});s.on('error',e=>{console.log('loopback_listen='+e.code);process.exitCode=1});
